description: This file defines the ArrayInput class, which extends Symfony's ArrayInput class to add a method for retrieving raw parameters. It is part of the command-line interface (CLI) framework within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the namespace OrangeHRM\Framework\Console.

classes.name: ArrayInput
classes.description: A subclass of Symfony's ArrayInput, providing an additional method to access raw parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayInput object with parameters and an optional InputDefinition.

methods.name: getRawParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters passed during object construction.
